nodes.claim: The local one-frustrated/five-aligned center-staple pattern is realizable.
The side-two cubical center complex satisfies d2 d1=0 and is exact at plaquettes.
The Stage 10 incident pattern forces at least five full negative plaquettes, and five is attained.
Connected exact center cocycles form a volume-uniform subcritical contour gas below an explicit q threshold.
Continuous noncentral collar failures admit an analogous charged activity.
The complete SU(2) link measure satisfies the nonlinear activity theorem.
